content.title: Liquid Apollo App - App Store
content.text: Fast, private, and reliable AI Free Chat with private, local AI models, connect to every open source AI, or your own locally-hosted private LLMs. Apollo is your own customizable client for accessing language models from all around the web. Local model support (powered by LEAP, a Liquid AI product): run smaller LLMs privately and securely on-device. OpenRouter support: bring an OpenRouter API key to chat with every model on the web. Just sign in by creating an account over at OpenRouter and paste it in to Apollo to access nearly every model, from open source models like Meta Llama 3, to closed source models like OpenAI’s ChatGPT-4. Custom Backend support: want ChatGPT at home? Run an LLM on your computer with tools like LM Studio or Ollama and connect to it with Apollo to host your own private ChatGPT-like mobile app for your family. I’ve been using Apollo AI for a little while now, and it’s honestly a pretty good app. It does exactly what it says lets you connect to services like OpenRouter and chat with different AI models right from your phone. The interface is clean, it feels smooth to use, and setup was straightforward. It’s nice not being tied to just one provider.What I like most is that it keeps things simple. You pick your model, type in your prompt, and go. If you’re into experimenting with different AIs or just want a reliable way to chat with one on your phone, it definitely gets the job done.Only real issue I’ve run into is with the ElevenLabs voice API specifically, the voice list doesn’t seem to load all your voices or custom ones. There’s a “tap to reload” button, but tapping it doesn’t really do anything. Not a dealbreaker, just a little annoying if you’re trying to use specific voices.Overall, good app. Nothing too fancy, but it works well and I’ve been enjoying it. after they fixed the TTS this app is again the best basic local AI. Simplicity is it's strength, there are many other local AI app that either don't work or are way to overcomplicated and buggy. This just works, be it with locally run on device AI are remote custom AI backend, I use it to access my Ollama server running on my desktop from anywhere, with voice to voice interface. it's great! only comparable app to this that works, with better TTS voice is the Ondevice AI, but that is quite buggy and too complicated and is not free! If you want a simple local AI solution that works and can connect to your own AI server remotely and has voice to voice functionality this is the one and only app out there.
